vectors.note: Two independent rules fire from two independent input fields, in the deterministic _RULE_GROUPS order (ring, band, stone, prong, setting, manufacturing, geometry). This is the current system's only form of 'multiple diagnostics' — there is no conflict between them, only co-occurrence. See docs/bible/06-forge/101-conflicts-precedence-and-resolution.md.
